item.title: $54.80 Japanese all-you-can-eat restaurant Mugen House opens new CBD location
item.description: After relocating, Mugen House is back with a reimagined space, and the all-you-can-eat offering Adelaide loves is back.

item.title: Adelaide weather forecast for Friday January 30th and the days ahead
item.description: It's heating up at the end of the work week! Here's your Friday forecast and moving into the weekend.

item.title: Andrea Michaels to step down from politics after seven year run
item.description: Premier Peter Malinauskas has thanked Andrea Michaels for her seven years of service as she steps down from South Australian politics and returns to her legal career.

item.title: South Australia records first net increase in public housing this century
item.description: New data released overnight confirms that a net increase in public housing stock has been achieved.

item.title: Riverland firefighting efforts grounded due to illegal drone flights as CFS issue plea
item.description: Illegal drone activity has once again grounded aerial firefighting in SA’s Riverland, forcing aircraft out of the sky and delaying critical response efforts.

item.title: Cellar Door Fest turns 15 this weekend, with 130+ SA producers under one roof
item.description: Running from 30 January to 1 February at the Adelaide Convention Centre, the huge event brings together South Australia’s hottest wine, spirits and artisan food producers under one roof.

item.title: South Australia secures world-leading Asia Pacific Autism Conference (APAC) for 2027
item.description: South Australia’s growing reputation as a leader in autism inclusion has been recognised on the global stage, with the state selected to host the Asia Pacific Autism Conference (APAC) in 2027.

item.title: Free boating safety app launches local content, helping SA boaties navigate rules, risks and conditions
item.description: South Australian boaties now have access to a free app designed to deliver real-time safety alerts, local rules, live maps and weather conditions — all tailored to the state’s waterways.

item.title: Adelaide Zoo and Monarto Safari Park receive new biosecurity funding amid global bird flu concerns
item.description: Adelaide Zoo and Monarto Safari Park will receive new federal funding to strengthen biosecurity measures and protect threatened native species from the potential threat of H5 bird flu.

item.title: South Australia locks in $2 billion hospital funding boost from the Commonwealth
item.description: South Australia has secured an extra $2 billion in federal funding for public hospitals, lifting total Commonwealth support to $15.2 billion and backing major hospital and workforce expansion across the state.
